evidence.description: LM $ MRR computation verified correct and in dollars (FIND-001 resolved).
Prior-STATE read/carry-forward verified (FIND-006 history half resolved).
Stale/never-ran log-age branching logic verified correct by static trace.
Both Capafy and Stripe parsers verified to fail-safe to NA on an error-shaped body, never masking as 0 (FIND-002/003 resolved).
Stripe live-key guard verified to fire on empty/non-live key (FIND-009 resolved).
STATE.md write verified atomic (tmp + mv), matching founder-loop.sh's pattern.
Verified 4 fixture-driven test cases exist and assert VALUE lines (not just status strings), a genuine improvement over iteration 1's zero tests.

antiFakeAssessment.neverFabricatesOrMasksARevenueNumber: MOSTLY YES for the specific 'API-error-as-$0' failure mode iteration 1 flagged (FIND-002/003 fully resolved: an error body now yields the string 'NA' + status READ-FAILED, never a fabricated 0). HOWEVER two residual risks remain that a fresh reader could still be misled by: (1) FIND-012 — a real 3-day Capafy figure is arithmetically combined with a real monthly LM figure and reported as a single '$X/mo' EARNING number, which is not fabricated but IS mislabeled/wrong-unit, so the headline dollar total can still be trusted less than it appears; (2) FIND-010 — a real positive EARNING figure computed this wake can be fully hidden by an unrelated HEAL-NEEDED string, an omission (not a fabrication) but still a trust-relevant gap in the one field most likely to be skimmed.
antiFakeAssessment.criticalNewRisk: FIND-011 — the test suite itself, on the very invariant (FIND-008, the 6-week silent Capafy death) this build claims to have fixed, has a real side effect that resets the real production staleness clock and provides zero coverage of the STALE/NEVER-RAN heal branches. This is the most serious finding of this iteration: the fix that was supposed to close the original incident is unverified and, if the test suite is ever run on this machine, actively defeats itself in production.
